hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"This repository keeps a decisions log at docs/DECISIONS.md. Read the section covering whatever you are about to change BEFORE changing it, and add or amend an entry in the SAME commit as any substantive change (new capability or dependency, schema or API change, tuned constant or threshold, a choice where a reasonable person would have chosen otherwise, or a deliberate decision NOT to do something the task implies). Every entry carries four parts: Decision, Why, Alternatives rejected, What this costs. If a change contradicts an existing entry, amend it and say so in your reply. If the change was not substantive, say that no entry was needed. See CLAUDE.md."}}'
